title: Fisher & Paykel — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Fisher & Paykel.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Designed for Real Life." Premium tier. Fisher & Paykel started in New Zealand in 1934 and brought a completely different design philosophy to North America. The DishDrawer is unlike anything else — two independent drawers that can run different cycles simultaneously. Their ActiveSmart refrigeration learns your usage patterns and adjusts temperature and airflow. Now owned by Haier Group, F&P is expanding rapidly in the luxury segment.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Design-forward luxury buyers. Customers who want something different from the Sub-Zero/Wolf standard. Compact kitchen solutions with the DishDrawer.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Fisher & Paykel:

• DishDrawer is completely unique — two independent drawers, no competitor has anything like it

• ActiveSmart fridge learns your habits and adjusts temperature automatically

• Minimal, clean New Zealand design aesthetic — no busy controls or clutter

• DCS outdoor brand for serious outdoor kitchens — commercial heritage

• Expanding luxury range lineup competing with Wolf and Thermador at lower price points
